title: Security Management Process

title: Risk Management
explanation: Control 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(B) (Risk Management) requires that: Implement security measures sufficient to reduce risks and vulnerabilities to a reasonable and appropriate level to comply with section 164.306(a).. Mandatory Technical Restriction: The security measures must be sufficient to reduce risks and vulnerabilities to a reasonable and appropriate level as per Section 164.306(a).. Implementation Prerequisite: Ensure that the implemented security controls meet the minimum requirements set forth in the HIPAA Security Rule..

title: Workforce Security
explanation: Control 164.308(a)(3)(i) (Workforce Security) requires that: Implement policies and procedures to ensure that all members of workforce have appropriate access to electronic protected health information.. Mandatory Technical Restriction: All members of the workforce must be granted only the necessary level of access to electronic protected health information based on their job responsibilities and roles within the organization.. Implementation Prerequisite: Develop and implement detailed access management policies and procedures that specify the minimum required permissions for each role..

title: Information Access Management
explanation: Control 164.308(a)(4)(i) (Information Access Management) requires that: Implement policies and procedures for authorizing access to electronic protected health information.. Mandatory Technical Restriction: The system must enforce strict authentication mechanisms that require multi-factor verification (MFA) for accessing sensitive patient data.. Implementation Prerequisite: All users must undergo MFA enrollment before they can access any protected health information..

title: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain electronic protected...
explanation: Control 164.312(a)(1) (Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain electronic protected...) requires that: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain electronic protected health information to allow access only to those persons or software programs that have been granted access rights.. Mandatory Technical Restriction: Access to electronic protected health information must be granted only to individuals or software programs with explicit access rights as defined by the organization's technical policies and procedures.. Implementation Prerequisite: The organization should develop and document its technical policies and procedures governing the management of electronic protected health information, including specific criteria for granting access rights..

title: Encryption and Decryption
explanation: Control 164.312(a)(2)(iv) (Encryption and Decryption) requires that: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt electronic protected health information.. Mandatory Technical Restriction: The encryption algorithm used must be supported by the healthcare organization's IT infrastructure and comply with relevant regulations such as HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act).. Implementation Prerequisite: The encryption key management process should include secure storage, access controls, and regular audits to ensure the confidentiality of the data..

title: Integrity Controls
explanation: Control 164.312(c)(1) (Integrity Controls) requires that: Implement policies and procedures to protect electronic protected health information from improper alteration or destruction.. Mandatory Technical Restriction: The system must implement mechanisms to ensure that all changes made to electronic protected health information (ePHI) are traceable and can be audited for integrity.. Implementation Prerequisite: Develop and enforce a comprehensive audit trail policy that includes logging of all modifications to ePHI..

title: Transmission Security
explanation: Control 164.312(e)(1) (Transmission Security) requires that: Implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to electronic protected health information that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.. Mandatory Technical Restriction: The transmission of electronic protected health information must be encrypted using industry-standard encryption protocols such as AES-256 before it is sent over any electronic communications network.. Implementation Prerequisite: All healthcare organizations must ensure that their systems meet the minimum requirements for implementing encryption technologies..
